title: Fox's Lachlan Murdoch claims there's "really no tension" with the NFL

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Fox's Lachlan Murdoch claims there's "really no tension" with the NFL
sources.description: On Monday, Fox CEO Lachlan Murdoch announced during an earnings call that the network will add a pair of nationally-televised games to its existing package for 2026.
